name: Signs
overview: Scripture reveals that signs serve distinct purposes ordained by God, such as marking times and seasons in creation, as seen in Genesis 1:14. Jesus acknowledges the human tendency to seek signs and wonders as a basis for belief, yet warns that some will receive only the sign of Jonah, emphasizing faith beyond miraculous proof (Matthew 16:4). Moreover, Jesus highlights that signs and wonders are often necessary to awaken belief, indicating their role in God's revelation and redemptive plan (John 4:48). Together, these verses show that signs are divine tools both for guidance and testing faith.
